settings.title: Every people process,
settings.intro: We rebuilt HR from the ground up around a single idea: the work should feel done before you think about it. Here's what that looks like in practice.

features.title: Payroll that runs itself
features.text: Set up a pay schedule once. Brightloop calculates wages, deductions, and benefits automatically, and reconciles the books on every single run.

features.title: Tax filing, handled
features.text: Federal, state, and local payroll taxes filed on time, everywhere you operate. Brightloop tracks every deadline so nobody has to.

features.title: Onboarding in minutes
features.text: Offer letters, tax forms, direct deposit, and policy acknowledgements — sent and collected before the first day, with the paperwork done for you.

features.title: Benefits without the binder
features.text: Offer, enroll, and manage health, retirement, and perks in one dashboard. Employees choose; Brightloop syncs the rest.

features.title: Time off that approves itself
features.text: Policy-aware PTO that respects your rules, balances automatically, and routes approvals to the right person. No more asking twice.

features.title: Compliance on autopilot
features.text: State posting requirements, pay-frequency rules, and wage statements — Brightloop keeps you current, and flags anything that changes.

settings.title: From hire to payday,

steps.title: Set up your team
steps.text: Import your people from a spreadsheet, a previous payroll, or invite them yourself. Brightloop fills in what it can as it loads.

steps.title: Run your first payroll
steps.text: Pick a schedule, review the numbers, and run. Brightloop computes wages, taxes, and benefits and reconciles the books for you.

steps.title: Let compliance ride
steps.text: Tax filings and regulatory updates happen in the background. Brightloop keeps every requirement current without you chasing them.

steps.title: Free your people team
steps.text: Redirect hours of admin toward what matters: hiring, developing, and keeping your team. The loop runs itself.

settings.note: Most teams run their first payroll in under an hour and never look back at a spreadsheet again.

settings.title: Simple pricing,
settings.intro: Every plan includes payroll, tax filing, onboarding, and benefits administration. Add seats as you grow — never in advance of needing them.

settings.title: The answers
settings.intro: The honest questions that come up before a company moves its people-and-payroll to Brightloop.

items.question: Is my payroll really filed automatically?
items.answer: Yes. Brightloop prepares and files federal, state, and local payroll taxes on time across all 50 states, and flags anything you need to review before each deadline.

items.question: Can I import my existing payroll and employee data?
items.answer: Absolutely. Bring your people over from a spreadsheet, your previous payroll, or your HRIS. Brightloop validates and cleans the data as it loads.

items.question: How long does onboarding take?
items.answer: The average team is running payroll within an hour. Onboarding new hires is self-serve and paperless — they complete their forms before their first day.

items.question: What happens to our data if we leave?
items.answer: Everything is yours. Export your employees, pay history, and documents anytime. Brightloop never holds your people hostage.
